Name: AgentJ
Author: Mega-Gorilla
Description: Your Claude Code and Codex sessions on the keys: see which need you, and press one to jump to its Windows 11 virtual desktop. Also switches virtual desktops.

Actions.Name: Desktop
Actions.Tooltip: One virtual desktop per key, numbered in reading order. Shows its name; press to switch to it. Keys beyond the number of desktops go dark.

Actions.Name: Desktop Info
Actions.Tooltip: The current desktop / the number of desktops, and its name. Press to read them again.

Actions.Name: Previous Desktop
Actions.Tooltip: Switch to the desktop on the left.

Actions.Name: Next Desktop
Actions.Tooltip: Switch to the desktop on the right.

Actions.Name: AI Session
Actions.Tooltip: One Claude Code / Codex session per key: its state by colour, its desktop top right. Press to jump to it. Choose the tool in the key's settings.

Actions.Name: AI Summary
Actions.Tooltip: How many sessions need you / have answered / are working. Press: jump to the next one waiting for you. Hold: choose which tools it jumps to.

Actions.Name: AI Page Previous
Actions.Tooltip: The previous page of AI sessions. Shows the page it goes to; orange when a session there needs you.

Actions.Name: AI Refresh
Actions.Tooltip: Read sessions and windows again now: put Codex sessions on the desktop of the ChatGPT window showing them, and clear sessions that look closed.

Actions.Name: AI Page Next
Actions.Tooltip: The next page of AI sessions. Shows the page it goes to; orange when a session there needs you.
